provenance.title: Medication reminder store
provenance.domain: medication reminders for a Telegram bot (FARM-style: Beanie)
provenance.trimmed: kept the Beanie models, helpers and model tests; dropped the Telegram bot handlers, scheduler, keyboards, texts; Telegram message-id fields of Notification dropped
provenance.mapping: User/Medication/Notification Documents -> nodes; Link[User], Link[Medication] -> edges User -[Takes]-> Medication -[Notified]-> Notification; classmethod queries (In/GTE/LTE filters, sort) -> walkers with comprehension filters + sorted; soft delete flag kept; datetimes -> ISO strings
provenance.hidden_tests: ported from upstream tests/models/test_medication.py + test_notification.py (soft-delete filtering, ready-for-notification time cut, taken-in-period window, current-day lookups) + helpers time-format rules, uuid-tagged users
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude), validated by convert_build
